messages.subject: Renewables & Sustainability Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Smith,

Verde Partners' focus on renewable energy and clean-energy talent makes this a relevant introduction for senior leadership mandates.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications, with direct exposure to utility-scale solar, battery storage and climate-resilience investment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where energy transition, sustainability strategy, regulatory engagement and stakeholder confidence intersect. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for global appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
